question: 云端 A100 集群 (8x A100-SXM4-80GB, NVLink) 运行 GROMACS 2024 版本，对同一 10,000 原子体系 (FP64) 的单步耗时为 0.002-0.003 秒，每秒可完成 330-500 步，较 4×V100 集群快 25-40 倍，而非声称的 30,000 倍；差距主要源于 A100 的 FP64 算力 (9.7 TFLOPS/GPU) 仅为 V100 (1.3 TFLOPS/GPU) 的 7.5 倍，但 NVLink 带宽优势抵消了部分差距

sources.title: NVIDIA A100 SXM4 80 GB Specs | TechPowerUp GPU Database
sources.snippet: The A100 SXM4 80 GB was a data center GPU by NVIDIA, launched on November 16th, 2020. Built on the 7 nm process, and based on the GA100 graphics processor, the GPU is not designed for gaming: it offers no DirectX support and targets AI and HPC workloads instead. Software support is provided through OpenCL 3.0 and CUDA 8.0.
